editorial_policy: Reviewed expansion records from authoritative agricultural and food-system sources. Store original source URL, publication date and verification date. Do not copy full articles.

records.title: FAO trains extension agents for climate-smart soybean demonstration farms in northern Ghana
records.summary: FAO trained 50 agricultural extension agents to support climate-smart soybean production through demonstration farms and farmer capacity building in northern Ghana.

records.title: Ghana farmers strengthen soil health and soil-carbon management
records.summary: FAO and Ghana's CSIR-Soil Research Institute are supporting farmers in Upper West Region with soil assessment and sustainable soil management under the RECSOIL Ghana pilot.

records.title: EU-FAO supports Feed Ghana Programme with 150,000 poultry birds
records.summary: FAO and the EU provided poultry birds, feed and training to farmers in northern Ghana to strengthen domestic production and rural livelihoods.

records.title: Ghana strengthens agricultural data through Earth Observation and farmer registries
records.summary: A regional ESTELLA training in Accra is strengthening use of Earth Observation and farmer registries for crop monitoring, agricultural statistics and early warning.

records.title: Ghana launches Cocoa Monitor coordination platform
records.summary: The Ghana Cocoa Monitor established a steering committee to strengthen data sharing, transparency and coordination across the cocoa value chain.

records.title: Ghana advances action to reduce antibiotic use in poultry and aquaculture
records.summary: Stakeholders developed a national roadmap under RENOFARM to improve disease prevention, veterinary services and responsible antimicrobial use.

records.title: Nigeria advances agrifood systems and climate-action convergence
records.summary: Government and development partners renewed efforts to align food-systems transformation with climate action and resilience investments.

records.title: FAO reports support for more than 200,000 vulnerable people with farming inputs in northeast Nigeria
records.summary: FAO and partners are supporting vulnerable farming households with agricultural inputs to restore food production and livelihoods during the rainy season.

records.title: Nigeria advances national food and nutrition crisis preparedness plans
records.summary: Nigeria is developing a digital coordination platform to centralize agricultural and nutrition data for food-security emergency planning and response.

records.title: Nigeria faces severe food-security pressures in northeast amid disrupted agricultural livelihoods
records.summary: FAO reports that conflict, economic pressures and climate risks are disrupting agricultural livelihoods, markets and food access in northeast Nigeria.

records.title: Malawi launches STOSAR II to strengthen agricultural systems
records.summary: Malawi, FAO, SADC and the EU launched the second phase of STOSAR II to strengthen agricultural information, animal health, pest surveillance and export readiness.

records.title: Climate-smart agriculture helps vulnerable communities build resilience in Malawi
records.summary: Communities in Chikwawa are using climate-smart agriculture approaches to cope with droughts, floods and erratic rainfall affecting farm livelihoods.

records.title: Malawi strengthens plant-health systems through digital innovation
records.summary: Malawi is strengthening plant-health capacity through digital approaches under the Africa Phytosanitary Programme to protect crops and agricultural trade.

records.title: Tanzania agrees on action plan to strengthen avocado value chain
records.summary: Government, researchers, farmers and private-sector actors agreed practical measures covering planting material, orchard management, post-harvest handling and markets for Tanzania's avocado sector.

records.title: Guinea supports restoration of degraded landscapes through assisted natural regeneration
records.summary: FAO launched training in Mamou to promote assisted natural regeneration, restore degraded land and strengthen community resilience to climate change.

records.title: Guinea uses sustainable energy to modernize agricultural infrastructure
records.summary: FAO supported photovoltaic systems at seed centres in Kilissi and Koba to improve energy resilience and strengthen agricultural infrastructure.

records.title: Lesotho strengthens capacity for sustainable potato value-chain development
records.summary: Lesotho is strengthening national capacity for potato value-chain development as the crop gains importance for food security and rural incomes.

records.title: FAO launches youth-led vegetable project in Lesotho
records.summary: A two-year youth-focused initiative aims to support Lesotho's fresh vegetable sector through training, enterprise development and market opportunities.

records.title: Potato value-chain development expands rural opportunities in Lesotho
records.summary: The potato sector is being strengthened through improved inputs, technical support, local seed development and stronger market opportunities.

records.title: Foot-and-mouth disease escalates across Southern Africa
records.summary: FAO reports an intensifying regional foot-and-mouth disease crisis affecting livestock production and trade, with major implications for Southern African farming communities.

records.title: Zimbabwe takes agrifood investment opportunities to FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: Zimbabwe is presenting a USD 1.65 billion agrifood investment portfolio covering maize, soyabean, blueberries, dairy and integrated water infrastructure.

records.title: Southern, Central and Eastern African countries strengthen coordinated PPR action
records.summary: A regional workshop in Dar es Salaam agreed measures for cross-border surveillance, preparedness, information sharing and control of Peste des Petits Ruminants affecting sheep and goats.

records.title: FAO expands livelihood and One Health support in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
records.summary: FAO is supporting communities affected by Ebola in Ituri and North Kivu with veterinary capacity, seeds, tools, poultry and cash assistance.

records.title: FAO strengthens early action ahead of drier Southern African season
records.summary: The Southern African Regional Climate Outlook Forum indicates below-normal rainfall across much of the region, prompting work on early agricultural action covering seed, feed, water and financing.

records.title: Zambia joins regional action to strengthen PPR surveillance and preparedness
records.summary: Zambia participated in the regional PPR workshop that agreed coordinated surveillance and preparedness measures and highlighted pathways toward maintaining PPR-free status.

records.title: West Africa strengthens climate and environment cooperation for agrifood resilience
records.summary: FAO's West Africa Climate and Environment mechanism met in Dakar to strengthen support for countries and advance climate-resilient agrifood systems.

records.title: Somalia highlights early-warning systems as a foundation for agricultural resilience
records.summary: FAO highlights Somalia's experience using food-security assessments, data systems and early warning mechanisms to strengthen timely resilience action.

records.title: Liberia agriculture ministry seeks US$69 million in 2027 budget to strengthen farmer support
records.summary: Liberia's Ministry of Agriculture is seeking increased 2027 budget support for farmer assistance and food production.

records.title: FAO-supported borehole improves water access for farmers in The Gambia
records.summary: A borehole supported by FAO is improving water access and reducing pressure around agricultural and community water needs in Ngunta.

records.title: FAO highlights fonio as an opportunity for nutrition, resilience and rural livelihoods in Ghana
records.summary: FAO highlighted fonio from northern Ghana as an ancient grain with potential to support nutrition, climate resilience and women producers' livelihoods.

records.title: FAO launches tools to help governments track agrifood public spending in Africa
records.summary: FAO launched tools designed to help governments track and allocate public spending across agrifood systems, with the launch taking place in Kigali.

records.title: FAO warns that hunger and malnutrition crises persist in Somalia amid flood and funding risks
records.summary: FAO reports continuing hunger and malnutrition pressures in Somalia, with projected flooding and funding shortfalls threatening vulnerable populations.

records.title: Togo’s SIHAM agricultural information platform moves into long-term operation
records.summary: The Food Systems Resilience Programme transferred the hydro-agrometeorological information platform and five digital kiosks to national farmer and institutional partners; services include weather, market, input, insurance and credit information.
records.source: Togo Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Animal Resources and Food Sovereignty

records.title: Seychelles ministry reviews tuna processing and value addition
records.summary: The fisheries and agriculture minister visited Indian Ocean Tuna Limited to review processing capacity, export operations, employment, sustainability and use of fish by-products across the tuna value chain.
records.source: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy

records.title: Seychelles and EU launch the 2026–2030 fisheries partnership protocol
records.summary: Seychelles and the European Union launched operations under their new sustainable fisheries partnership protocol and approved sectoral support priorities, including artisanal fishing communities, aquaculture development, research and monitoring.
records.source: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy

records.title: Seychelles explores marine science and seafood-processing cooperation with China
records.summary: A Seychelles delegation took part in the 2026 Global Ocean Development Forum and visited marine science and seafood-processing institutions while exploring cooperation on sustainable marine industries and resource management.
records.source: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy

records.title: Chad strengthens local flour value chains through a new food-processing study
records.summary: FAO, Chad’s Ministry of Agricultural Production and Industrialization, the World Food Programme and the European Union brought together public institutions, producers, processors and partners to validate a study of fortified and unfortified flour value chains. The work is intended to guide action on local processing, market competitiveness and nutrition-sensitive food systems.
records.review_reason: Direct official FAO story verified. Complete and review the five-language content before publication.

records.title: Tunisia’s FAO-backed ASCO project brings exporters into phytosanitary system modernization
records.summary: Under the EU-funded ASCO project, FAO and Tunisia’s plant-health authorities consulted more than 30 agricultural production units involved in exports. Discussions covered digital phytosanitary information and integrated pest management, aiming to reduce non-compliance risks and help producers meet export-market requirements.
records.review_reason: Direct official FAO story verified. Complete and review the five-language content before publication.

records.title: FAO and Egypt’s remote-sensing authority explore climate-resilience collaboration
records.summary: FAO’s Near East and North Africa regional office met Egypt’s National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences to discuss cooperation on landscape restoration, sustainable land management, land-use monitoring and geospatial tools for early warning of drought and land degradation.
records.source: FAO Regional Office for the Near East and North Africa
records.review_reason: Direct official FAO story verified. Complete and review the five-language content before publication.

records.title: Algeria and Norway explore cooperation in fisheries and aquaculture
records.summary: Algeria’s agriculture, rural development and fisheries minister met Norway’s fisheries and ocean-policy minister to discuss sustainable fisheries, modernizing facilities, seafood processing, investment and technical cooperation in aquaculture.
records.source: Algerian Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Egypt and Spain discuss agricultural trade and investment
records.summary: Egypt’s agriculture minister met Spain’s agriculture minister to discuss agricultural trade, cooperative development, farmer insurance, quarantine procedures, greenhouse farming, irrigation efficiency and investment opportunities.

records.title: Mauritania prepares national vegetable-growing campaign
records.summary: The prime minister chaired an interministerial meeting on the upcoming vegetable campaign, discussing support for local production, agricultural inputs, fertilizer tax exemptions, marketing, storage, water and electricity access.
records.source: National Drilling and Wells Company, Mauritania

records.title: Early autumn rains raise hopes for Morocco’s new farming season
records.summary: Moroccan farmers are preparing soil, seeds, fertilizers and irrigation infrastructure for the new planting season, while producers in rain-dependent and irrigated regions await more sustained rainfall.

records.title: Heatwaves damage Tunisia’s autumn tomato production prospects
records.summary: The Tunisian farmers’ union reported that high temperatures during flowering reduced tomato flower retention and fruit development, affecting autumn harvest prospects in key production areas.

records.title: Tunisia reviews the 2026 cereal harvest and prepares the next sowing campaign
records.summary: Tunisia’s cereals office scheduled a national conference to review the 2025–2026 cereal collection campaign and coordinate logistics for the 2026–2027 sowing season.

records.title: Gabon places state agriculture company SAEG under temporary administration
records.summary: Following the lapse of legal orders that would have dissolved the Société d’Agriculture et d’Élevage du Gabon, the cabinet confirmed SAEG remains the state’s agricultural vehicle and ordered a temporary administration to protect its assets, audit operations and review strategy.

records.title: Libya opens its international agricultural and livestock development exhibition
records.summary: The Tripoli exhibition brought together agricultural and livestock-sector bodies, local and international companies, and equipment and technology providers, with a focus on development of crop and animal production and protection of agricultural land and pasture.

records.title: AfDB publishes completion report for Comoros emergency agricultural production support
records.summary: The African Development Bank’s completion report reviews an emergency project designed to strengthen local food production and resilience, including maize, potato and sweet-potato production and support for poultry and vulnerable households.

records.title: Chad restricts grain exports and waives import duties amid food shortages
records.summary: The Chadian government announced emergency measures after heat and drought damaged crops, including a ban on exports of staple grains and customs-duty exemptions for imported grain to help address food shortages.

records.title: Gabon and FAO strengthen farmer capacity with agricultural and fisheries equipment
records.summary: FAO, working with the Government of Gabon, delivered agricultural and fisheries equipment to project beneficiaries in Lébamba following months of training. The initiative supports agricultural modernization, production conditions and food security, with attention to women and young people.
records.review_reason: Direct official FAO story verified. Review its age and prepare reviewed five-language content before publication.

records.title: Niger produces its first potato seed crop with FAO support
records.summary: FAO reports that Niger harvested 18.8 tonnes of certified G3 potato seed from an initial 550 kilograms of mini-tubers, a pilot result intended to build national seed-production capacity and reduce reliance on imports.
records.review_reason: Direct official FAO story verified. Review and prepare five-language content before publication.

records.title: FAO GIEWS country brief: Equatorial Guinea’s 2026 crop and food-import outlook
records.summary: FAO’s country brief assesses 2026 production prospects for cassava, sweet potatoes and plantains, forecasts food imports near average levels, and summarizes recent inflation trends. It is a country-situation reference rather than a breaking-news article.
records.review_reason: Official country situation brief, not a conventional news article. Editorial review required to confirm placement and multilingual presentation.

records.title: FAO GIEWS country brief: Libya’s 2026 cereal outlook and food inflation
records.summary: FAO’s country brief reviews mixed weather effects on Libya’s 2026 wheat and barley prospects, above-average cereal import requirements for 2026/27, and rising food inflation. It is a country-situation reference rather than a breaking-news article.
records.review_reason: Official country situation brief, not a conventional news article. Editorial review required to confirm placement and multilingual presentation.

records.title: FAO GIEWS country brief: Republic of the Congo’s 2026 maize and cereal-import outlook
records.summary: FAO’s country brief reports generally favourable weather for the 2026 maize crop, an above-average cereal import forecast and the current national economic outlook. It is a country-situation reference rather than a breaking-news article.
records.review_reason: Official country situation brief, not a conventional news article. Editorial review required to confirm placement and multilingual presentation.

records.title: Niger ministry reports on the 2026 agropastoral campaign monitoring mission
records.summary: The ministry’s October bulletin describes inspections of irrigation infrastructure, tomato production development, livestock services, feed-storage works and regional agricultural support during the 2026 campaign.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, Niger
records.review_reason: Official monthly archive located, but the direct article URL must be confirmed before publication.

records.title: Niger ministry reports inspections of licensed private veterinary establishments
records.summary: An October ministry bulletin describes a regional inspection mission checking veterinary-practice authorizations, medicine approval, storage conditions and cold-chain compliance in Zinder.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, Niger
records.review_reason: Official monthly archive located, but the direct article URL must be confirmed before publication.

records.title: Equatorial Guinea advances plans for an agro-food laboratory
records.summary: The government press service reports that the prime minister is advancing implementation of an agro-food laboratory intended to support food quality and agricultural development.
records.source: Guinea Ecuatorial Press, Government of Equatorial Guinea
records.review_reason: Official news listing located, but the direct article URL must be confirmed before publication.

records.title: Grande Foire Agricole du Congo 2026 prepares agricultural exhibitions and sector meetings
records.summary: The official fair website advertises agricultural exhibitions, producer and investor meetings, machinery and input displays, training and agribusiness networking ahead of the 2026 event.
records.source: Grande Foire Agricole du Congo, official event site
records.review_reason: Official event landing page located, but a dated direct news or event notice is required before publication.

records.title: Burundi farmers highlight fertilizer, seed, market and post-harvest challenges
records.summary: At an agricultural and livestock exhibition in Gitega, producers highlighted climate impacts, limited access to fertilizer and improved seed, weak market access, low farm-gate prices and crop losses linked to storage and preservation constraints.

records.title: FAO warns of below-average rainfall and crop risks in Eritrea
records.summary: FAO’s September country brief reports that the 2026 Kiremti rainy season performed poorly, with rainfall 20–40 percent below average in several main crop-producing regions and risks to the upcoming harvest of wheat, barley, sorghum, maize, teff and pulses.

records.title: Madagascar promotes resilient agriculture and food sovereignty at Africa Food Systems Forum 2026
records.summary: Madagascar’s agriculture ministry outlined priorities for resilient food systems, climate adaptation, agricultural infrastructure and stronger domestic production while participating in the Africa Food Systems Forum in Kigali.
records.source: Madagascar Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: FAO and UNHCR expand livelihood and inclusive-finance support in northern Cameroon
records.summary: FAO and UNHCR agreed to support refugees and host communities in northern Cameroon through agricultural support, capacity building and access to financial services. Planned activities include support for 50 producer organizations, Farmer Field Schools reaching about 1,250 people, and 100 savings and credit groups.

records.title: Moroccan women olive farmers share value-chain experience at MOSAIC 2026
records.summary: FAO and CIHEAM Bari brought women producers, cooperatives and entrepreneurs together for a regional exchange on olive farming, oil quality, post-harvest management, certification, traceability and market access. Morocco's Taymate Cooperative was represented by its president, Rabha Imloui.

records.title: Niger produces its first certified potato seed crop with FAO support
records.summary: Niger produced 18.8 tonnes of certified G3 potato seed from an initial 550 kilograms of mini-tubers through a pilot supported by FAO and the national agricultural research institute. The initiative also trained 204 producers in cultivation practices and seed certification.

records.title: FAO strengthens hygiene and food-safety practices in Central African Republic abattoirs
records.summary: FAO trained 25 stakeholders in Bangui on abattoir hygiene, meat inspection, ante-mortem and post-mortem checks, HACCP principles and sanitation to help improve food safety across the meat supply chain.
records.source: FAO in the Central African Republic

records.title: Guinea-Bissau joins FAO's responsible agricultural investment coaching initiative
records.summary: FAO is supporting a local coaching ecosystem to help young and women-led agricultural entrepreneurs develop sustainable, bankable projects and improve access to business-development support.

records.title: FAO and Libya's agriculture minister discuss cooperation on agrifood transformation
records.summary: FAO Director-General Qu Dongyu met Libya's Minister for Agriculture and Livestock to discuss continued cooperation and priorities under Libya's country programming framework for agrifood-system transformation.
records.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

records.title: Namibia's Japan-funded resilience project delivers first inputs to drought-affected farming communities
records.summary: FAO, Namibia's agriculture ministry and the Government of Japan handed over the first project inputs to farming communities in Hardap Region under an initiative promoting adaptive agriculture and drought resilience.

records.title: Bush encroachment threatens agriculture in Botswana’s North West District
records.summary: Botswana’s North West District Council warned that bush encroachment and declining rangeland threaten livestock production and rural livelihoods. The report also describes farmer training in seed production and integrated pest management.
records.source: DailyNews (Botswana Government Communication & Information Systems; BOPA)

records.title: Pitsane grain-silo refurbishment planned to improve Botswana’s storage capacity
records.summary: Botswana Agricultural Marketing Board reported that refurbishment of five Pitsane silos, with combined capacity of 25,000 tonnes, was being prepared after equipment and materials were procured. The report noted that the timing could depend on clearing the remaining harvest.
records.source: DailyNews (Botswana Government Communication & Information Systems; BOPA)

records.title: Botswana veterinary officials urge farmers to follow foot-and-mouth disease controls
records.summary: At a consultative meeting in Kanye, Botswana’s Department of Veterinary Services urged cattle owners to follow containment rules and prevent animals from crossing the control fence. Officials said culling is a last resort and stressed the need for farmer cooperation to limit disease spread.
records.source: DailyNews (Botswana Government Communication & Information Systems; BOPA)

records.title: Morocco ADA highlights financing models for smallholder farmers and agrifood value chains
records.summary: Morocco’s Agricultural Development Agency reported on a seminar focused on agricultural financial inclusion. Discussions covered solidarity-based agriculture, rural entrepreneurship, local products, aggregation, agricultural data and ways to improve smallholder farmers’ access to suitable finance.

records.title: Eswatini urges farmers to plant early and prepare for El Niño risks
records.summary: Eswatini’s government urged farmers to plant early, consider drought-tolerant crop varieties, diversify production, conserve water and protect livestock as the 2026–27 season approaches amid El Niño concerns.

records.title: Eswatini farmers urged to keep cultivating despite predicted El Niño
records.summary: A local report describes advice for Eswatini farmers to continue cultivation while planning for forecast El Niño conditions, including careful crop choices and risk management for livestock and water.

records.title: EU–ITC programme works to strengthen women’s roles in Eswatini’s livestock sector
records.summary: An EU-supported initiative reported training 133 livestock farmers, 58 percent of them women, while broader activities aim to build skills among farmers, agribusinesses and extension officers in sustainable rangeland management.
records.source: European External Action Service (EEAS), distributed via PublicNow

records.title: São Tomé and Príncipe advances a national “100% Bio” sustainability strategy
records.summary: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Rural Development describes a national vision to connect organic production, food security, biodiversity, jobs, tourism, environmental protection and the blue economy. The RETSA project is identified as a platform for putting the vision into practice.
records.source: São Tomé and Príncipe Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Rural Development (MAPDR)

records.title: World Bank approves US$60 million for Congo poultry and aquaculture value chains
records.summary: The World Bank Group approved US$60 million to strengthen competitiveness and climate resilience in the Republic of the Congo’s poultry and aquaculture value chains, including improved access to feed, fingerlings and day-old chicks, skills development, productive infrastructure in selected Protected Agricultural Zones, and finance for producers and investors.
records.review_reason: Direct World Bank press release checked; awaiting editorial approval before publication.

records.title: Cabo Verde: IFAD approves €8.844 million for the PRO-AGUA resilient agriculture programme
records.summary: Cabo Verde’s Ministry of Agriculture and Environment reported that IFAD approved €8.844 million in financing for PRO-AGUA, a programme designed to improve sustainable, inclusive water access for climate-resilient agriculture on Santo Antão, São Nicolau, Santiago and Fogo. The financing agreement and national ratification formalities were still the next steps at publication.
records.source: Cabo Verde Ministry of Agriculture and Environment
records.review_reason: Direct ministry article checked; awaiting editorial approval before publication.

records.title: Mauritius announces 2026–2027 fruit-protection financial assistance scheme
records.summary: Mauritius’ Ministry of Agro-Industry announced a financial assistance plan covering fruit-protection nets for orchard owners and the public. The scheme offers a 50% subsidy, subject to conditions, for up to five backyard fruit trees or 60 trees in orchards. The scheme’s stated validity period is 1 October to 6 November 2026; applicants should confirm eligibility and availability with FAREI.
records.source: Mauritius Ministry of Agro-Industry, Food Security, Blue Economy and Fisheries
records.review_reason: Direct ministry communiqué checked; current eligibility and availability still require editorial confirmation before publication.

records.title: World Bank approves financing to improve Togo’s logistics links to agricultural production areas
records.summary: The World Bank approved US$200 million to improve Togo’s transport and logistics systems, including connections between high-potential agricultural production areas and markets. The programme is intended to reduce post-harvest losses, improve market access and strengthen agri-food competitiveness; it is infrastructure financing, not a direct farmer grant.
records.review_reason: Direct World Bank press release checked; awaiting editorial approval before publication.

records.title: FAO supports food-safety training for Togo’s agricultural value chain
records.summary: FAO reported an August 2026 training-of-trainers workshop in Togo to strengthen good hygiene practices and HACCP-based food-safety skills across the food value chain. The initiative supports safer food trade and stronger national food-control capacity.
records.review_reason: Direct FAO article checked; awaiting editorial approval before publication.

records.title: Togo–Burkina Faso cassava trade talks identify a potential 80,000-tonne market
records.summary: Togo’s agriculture ministry reported a cross-border business-matching meeting linking Togolese cassava producers and processors with the Interprofession Manioc du Burkina Faso. The article describes an estimated demand signal of 80,000 tonnes of cassava paste and follow-up work on volumes, quality, pricing and delivery; this is a developing market lead, not a confirmed purchase contract.
records.source: Togo Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Animal Resources and Food Sovereignty
records.review_reason: Direct ministry article checked and its Burkina Faso relevance confirmed; awaiting editorial approval before publication.

records.title: FAO and Seychelles discuss cooperation on fisheries, agriculture and aquaculture
records.summary: FAO Director-General QU Dongyu met Seychelles’ Minister for Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy during the September 2026 Committee on Fisheries session. The official report notes continued collaboration on fisheries and aquaculture; it is a cooperation update rather than a funding call.
records.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
records.review_reason: Direct FAO article checked; awaiting editorial approval before publication.
